processAdjustments: The snapshot handed to the product-manager reviewer excluded the .agents/ tree that holds the task's authoritative implementation and test files, forcing verification against the source worktree; include every path referenced by the completion matrix in future review snapshots.

Record the Pester summary JSON as a machine-readable artifact next to the run (as done in research/final-local-verification.md) for every checkpoint, so a reviewer without a Pester host can still tie counts to a timestamp and file list.

Keep the strict claim predicates (Test-CapacityClaimSchemaVersion, Test-CapacitySubmissionNotAttempted) as the single shared gate for handoff, CAS, and release; any future path that inspects the claim should call them rather than re-implementing a comparison, which is what caused the first FINAL rejection.
finalReview.productManagerStatement: 原始诉求已完全实现：RootWait 不再在进入 adapter send 之前把 submissionAttempted 标为 true。现在容量 claim 使用独立的 schema 2（watcher/evidence 与 batch manifest 仍为 1），直接 run-root 与批处理 child 都以 run-starting/submissionAttempted=false 启动，唯一一次 false->true 的原子转换在互斥锁内、紧邻唯一的 Invoke-WatchAdapterSend 之前完成并写入时间戳；转换失败即抛 ConcurrencySlotRecoveryRequired 且不会触达 adapter。owner 已死亡或已观察到完成、且证据目录没有任何持久证据的 schema 2 run-starting/false 槽，可凭 never-invoked 证明安全回收；schema 1 的模糊 claim、submissionAttempted=true、以及任何非规范 schema 或非布尔值都继续 fail closed 保留槽位。exact-once、禁止自动重发、不删除 idempotency/target claim、3/6 容量与 7200 秒默认值均未改变。AC1–AC8 全部勾选并有代码、测试与规格对应；前一次 FINAL 拒绝提出的三项（跑完整 sidebar 套件、统一 Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff 严格判断、勾选 AC8）均已闭环，最终本地完整 sidebar 为 322/322（watcher 134/134、adapter 188/188）。实现已在隔离 worktree 本地提交 685e680，未推送、未发布、未安装。唯一提醒：本次审阅环境没有 Pester，测试计数依据的是带时间戳的 JSON 记录而非我本人复跑；另外历史遗留的两个 schema 1 模糊槽按设计仍保持隔离，需要人工判断后再清理。建议现在执行归档，并在任何部署或回滚前确认没有 in-flight batch。
finalReview.recommendedNextAction: Close out the task: run trellis-finish-work/archive for gptpro-pre-send-slot-recovery, flip task.json status to completed with completedAt set, and before any deploy or rollback of the watcher script confirm there is no in-flight batch so old and new parent/child handoff versions cannot interleave.

processAdjustments: Attach raw command output (Pester summary lines, git diff --stat) to the task evidence rather than only prose counts in implement.md - the first FINAL rejection was caused by stale AC8 numbers that a pasted summary would have made self-evident.

When a predicate becomes the safety boundary for a release decision, assert it from every call site in one shared test case; the coercive handoff check slipped through because handoff, CAS and release validated the schema separately.
pmReview.productManagerStatement: 这个改动解决了你报告的真实故障：以前 run-root 和批处理父进程在真正调用 adapter 之前就把容量槽标成「已尝试提交」，结果一个从未发出任何内容的空槽会被永久占用，只能人工清理。现在容量 claim 使用独立的 schema 2（watcher 与 batch manifest 仍是 1），槽在整个启动、参数校验和 batch 交接期间保持 run-starting/submissionAttempted=false，只有在 Invoke-RootWaitRound 里紧邻唯一一次 Invoke-WatchAdapterSend 之前，才由一个持锁的 compare-and-swap 原子写入 true 和时间戳；直接路径与 batch child 共用这同一个边界，child 不再二次获取容量，父进程仍是唯一释放者。恢复侧是保守的：只有 schema 2、run-starting、真布尔 false、没有任何 state.json/watch-state.json/watch-event.json/evidence.json、且没有 watcherId 或 terminalStatus 的 claim 才会被判为 never-invoked 并安全回收；旧 schema、已越过边界的 true、身份或版本不匹配、以及任何矛盾的持久证据，依旧返回 ConcurrencySlotRecoveryRequired 并保留槽。恢复路径不碰浏览器、不重发、不删 idempotency/target claim，3/6/7200 的限额和既有绑定都没有变。你上次拒收的两点都已落实：Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff 现在与 CAS、释放路径共用同一套严格谓词（只接受 Int32/Int64 的规范整数 2），AC8 记录也已刷新为完整 sidebar 322/322（watcher 134/134、adapter 188/188）。需要说明的是，本次审查环境禁止执行外部程序，所以这些测试数字和「diff 不含无关改动」是转述实施方的结果，我没有重新跑一遍复核。剩下未勾选的两项是有意留在验收之后的：trellis-finish-work/archive，以及部署或回滚前确认没有 in-flight batch——后者建议保留为发布门禁，避免新旧 parent/child 交接版本交错。
